excluded_noise_reason: markdown report/status fragments leaked into guild_audit_log.intent against unrelated guilds (git/bash/comfy_ui/code_reviewer) -- audit pipeline bug, reported separately
majority_class_baseline_note: always predicting 'Direct' (34/44 of my own hand labels) beats DistilBERT+LogReg (75.00%). Skewed label distribution (34 Direct / 9 Reactive / 1 Proactive) makes accuracy_pct alone a misleading metric -- retracting the original GO verdict.
deep_labels_comparison: Deep independently labeled the same 55 raw intents via a heuristic scorer: 54/55 Direct, 1 Reactive, 0 Proactive -- an even more degenerate distribution than my manual labels, meaning inter-rater agreement is dominated by the trivial majority class and doesn't validate the DistilBERT signal either.
verdict_basis: accuracy_pct alone was misleading -- corrected verdict compares against the majority-class baseline (77.27%), which DistilBERT+LogReg (75.00%) does not beat on this real, hand-labeled, class-imbalanced production set. Do not integrate into routing.rs on this evidence. Needs a class-balanced held-out set (more genuinely Reactive/Proactive real intents) before re-evaluating.
